candidates: When a refactor removes all consumers of an exported symbol, remove the export itself rather than leaving it as dead code. Before keeping any export, verify it has at least one import site elsewhere in the codebase.

Name all database-related identifiers using the all-caps suffix `DB`, not `Db` or `db` — e.g., `CommonDB`, `commonDB`, `DiagramDB`. This is consistent with the existing `DiagramDB` interface convention in the project.
